conclusion.emissary: New named, visually useful partial source-view reference from official asset filename: main dome and faceplate visible, superior appendage tips cropped and excluded. Publisher-page link and 1:1 certification remain unverified.
conclusion.amazonPirate: New visibly useful bundle render, but Amazon-left mapping is a legacy declaration; keep identity limitation explicit and do not treat as fresh named-mask proof.
conclusion.launchClasses: Three official masked class portraits accessible, but individual Hunter/Scout/Berserker assignment unproven; no arbitrary generation by name.
conclusion.anubisWitch: No concrete new official PS article or exact local source asset URL found in this bounded pass.

network: Five official pages and five exact source images returned HTTP200. Initial sandbox proxy-connect failures were followed by identical approved outside-sandbox retries. No forum/PHG-homepage/Sideshow retry, mirrors, proxy bypass, bulk guessed URLs, game download or mod execution.
correctionNote: Removed initial whole-helmet/complete wording after joint source review confirmed two superior projections are clipped at the horizontal foreground boundary near y197.
